project.name: open-evora
project.objective: Evidence-first civic problem investigation and validation for Évora, governed by the canonical SRC → EVD → PRB model
targetUsers: residents, students, workers, businesses, public bodies, and visitors in Évora

constraints: Research follows docs/investigationstrategy.md and the canonical SRC → EVD → PRB semantics in docs/datamodel.md.
Direct engagement and any canonical integration follow the public-repository, privacy, and evidence-integrity safeguards in AGENTS.md.
Research records use the executable schemas in research/schemas/ and deterministic validation in tools/research/.
nonGoals: No automatic research-state transition from deterministic validation.
technologyPreferences: Node.js (already available) for the research-record validator.
